newsitem.title: MEXICO: IDB approves $915 million loan for Mexico.
newsitem.headline: IDB approves $915 million loan for Mexico.

text.p: The Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) on Thursday signed three separate loans to Mexico worth a total $915 million, an IDB official said.
Jairo Sanchez, the IDB representative in Mexico, said the loans would be given to Mexico's state public works bank Banobras and state development bank Nacional Financiera.
Sanchez said the money would be aimed at the labor market and environmental programs.

One loan worth $365 million will be aimed at water projects in Mexico City to prevent flooding in the capital and clean up wastewater that runs from Mexico City to the farming regions of Hidalgo and Veracruz states.
Separate loans of $250 million and $300 million will be aimed at modernizing Mexico's labor market through worker retraining programs and a program to increase worker savings.
